54050-little-wideawake-a-story-book-for-.title: _A Story Book for Little Children_
54050-little-wideawake-a-story-book-for-.creator: Mrs. Sale Barker
54050-little-wideawake-a-story-book-for-.description: A book by Mrs. Sale Barker. At last we arrived at the station;--the children still in uproarious spirits, though with cherry noses, as well as rosy cheeks, from the cold. I must tell you that there was snow upon the ground; and as, unluckily, we had ten minutes to wait for the train, they began to amuse themselves by snowballing each other. Frank set the example, and they found it such fun that I scolded, and begged them to be quiet, in vain.

arxiv-1607-00340.title: Elastic Graphs
arxiv-1607-00340.creator: Dylan P. Thurston
arxiv-1607-00340.description: Abstract . An elastic graph is a graph with an elasticity associated to each edge. It may be viewed as a network made out of ideal rubber bands. If the rubber bands are stretched on a target space there is an elastic energy .

arxiv-1903-10508.title: The Holographic Fishchain
arxiv-1903-10508.creator: Nikolay Gromov, Amit Sever
arxiv-1903-10508.description: Abstract We present the first-principle derivation of a weak-strong duality between the fishnet theory in four dimensions and a discretized string-like model living in five dimensions. At strong coupling, the dual description becomes classical and we demonstrate explicitly the classical integrability of the model.

arxiv-2012-02372.title: Guiding Principle for Minor-Embedding in Simulated-Annealing-Based Ising Machines
arxiv-2012-02372.creator: TATSUHIKO SHIRAI 1, SHU TANAKA 2,3, NOZOMU TOGAWA, 1
arxiv-2012-02372.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by TATSUHIKO SHIRAI 1, SHU TANAKA 2,3, NOZOMU TOGAWA, 1. We propose a novel type of minor-embedding (ME) in simulated-annealing-based Ising machines. The Ising machines can solve combinatorial optimization problems. Many combinatorial optimization problems are mapped to find the ground (lowest-energy) state of the logical Ising model. When connectivity is restricted on Ising machines, ME is required for mapping from the logical Ising model to a physical Ising model, which corresponds to a specific Ising machine.

arxiv-2212-01928.title: Space-Time- and Frequency- Spreading for Interference Minimization in Dense IoT
arxiv-2212-01928.creator: Indrakshi Dey, and Nicola Marchetti
arxiv-2212-01928.description: Abstract In this article, we propose a space spreading-assisted framework that leverages either time or frequency diversity or both to reduce interference and signal loss owing to channel impairments and facilitate the efficient operation of large-scale dense Internet-of-Things (IoT). Our approach employs dispersion of data-streams transmitted from individual IoT devices over indexed space-time (ST), space-frequency (SF) or space-time-frequency (STF) blocks.

arxiv-2308-01098.description: Abstract . In the dynamic landscape of online advertising, decoding user intent remains a pivotal challenge, particularly in the context of query classification. Swift classification models, exemplified by FastText, cater to the demand for real-time responses but encounter limitations in handling intricate queries. Conversely, accuracy-centric models like BERT introduce challenges associated with increased latency.

arxiv-2410-00596.title: Dynamic and Scalable Data Preparation for Object-Centric Process Mining
arxiv-2410-00596.creator: Lien Bosmans, Jari Peeperkorn, Alexandre Goossens, Giovanni Lugaresi, Johannes De Smedt, Jochen De Weerdt
arxiv-2410-00596.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lien Bosmans, Jari Peeperkorn, Alexandre Goossens, Giovanni Lugaresi, Johannes De Smedt, Jochen De Weerdt. Object-centric process mining is emerging as a promising paradigm across diverse industries, drawing substantial academic attention. To support its data requirements, existing object-centric data formats primarily facilitate the exchange of static event logs between data owners, researchers, and analysts, rather than serving as a robust foundational data model for continuous data ingestion and transformation pipelines for subsequent storage and analysis.

arxiv-2501-01233.title: The clock advance description of the Epidemic Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model Thanks: DFG SFB 1294
arxiv-2501-01233.description: Abstract In this short paper we propose to extend the ETAS model to micro-seismic events. For that we interpret the triggered events in an ETAS model as individual local clock advances of an independent background process. The solution of the ETAS model thus becomes the sum of an infinite Markov chain of independent time adjusted background processses.

pmc-10736230.title: SOCIAL PARTICIPATION, LONELINESS, AND CIRCADIAN RHYTHMS OF MIDDLE-AGED AND OLDER ADULTS IN TAIWAN
pmc-10736230.creator: Unknown
pmc-10736230.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Loneliness among middle-aged and older adults is a growing public health concern in the aging society. While social participation is known as a protective factor against loneliness, not all older adults enjoy social participation. The purpose of this study is to investigate the social participation and loneliness characteristics in communities and their association with the demographic data, health-related variables, objective sleep parameters and rest-activity circadian rhythms with a sample of 242 Taiwan community-dwelling middle-aged and older adults aged 45 to 89 years.

pmc-11555151.title: Pelvic autonomic dysfunction is common in patients with pure autonomic failure
pmc-11555151.creator: E Vichayanrat, C Hentzen, S Simeoni, M Pakzad, V Iodice, Jalesh N Panicker
pmc-11555151.description: Background and PurposePure autonomic failure (PAF) presents primarily as cardiovascular autonomic failure and may phenoconvert to other neurodegenerative disorders. However, the involvement of other autonomic functions has been poorly evaluated. This study aims to characterize genitourinary and bowel dysfunction and explore their relationship with cardiovascular autonomic dysfunction.

pmc-11632830.title: Perioperative patient safety recommendations: systematic review of clinical practice guidelines
pmc-11632830.creator: Ismael Martinez-Nicolas, Daniel Arnal-Velasco, Eva Romero-García, Neus Fabregas, Yolanda Sanduende Otero, Irene Leon, Ashish A Bartakke, Javier Silva-Garcia, Anna Rodriguez, Claudia Valli, Sandro Zamarian, Adam Zaludek, Jose Meneses-Echavez, Andrés F Loaiza-Betancur, Paulo Sousa, Carola Orrego, Vict
pmc-11632830.description: BackgroundSurgical-related incidents are a common cause of in-hospital adverse events. Surgical patient safety would benefit from evidence-based practices, but a comprehensive collection of patient safety recommendations is still lacking. This study aimed to compile and assess the perioperative patient safety recommendations for adults.

pmc-12470972.title: Changes in Phytochemical, Physiological, and Morphological Traits in Pelargonium graveolens as Affected by Drought Stress and Ascophyllum nodosum Extract
pmc-12470972.creator: Negar Gerami, Mehdi Rahimmalek, Mahdiyeh Gholami, Behnaz Tohidi, Antoni Szumny, Ivana Sola
pmc-12470972.description: Nowadays, the use of natural biological bio-stimulants such as seaweed extract (SWE) is highly considered for alleviating the adverse effects of drought stress in many plant species. This study evaluated the effects of drought stress and foliar application of seaweed extract (SWE) on the morphological, physiological, and phytochemical traits of Pelargonium graveolens.

pmc-12743113.title: Liensinine can improve vascular remodeling in hypertension through the ferroptosis-related TLR4 inflammatory pathway
pmc-12743113.creator: Daxin Chen, Peizhi Jia, Meiling Wang, Baojie Du, Haitao Du, Xi Huang, Jianwei Zeng, Qiaoyan Cai, Ling Zhang, Ying Zhu, Shan Lin, Dawei Lian, Jun Peng
pmc-12743113.description: Vascular remodeling, which results in aortic sclerosis, is one of the main risk factors for hypertension-related cardiovascular events. In the process of early intervention and clinical improvement, the inhibition of this process is very important. Previous studies have shown that liensinine (Lien) alleviates hypertension-induced vascular remodeling, but its mechanism of action remains unclear.

pmc-12754984.title: Psychosocial and digital predictors of Hepatitis B vaccination uptake in healthcare workers: insights from a Nigerian tertiary hospital
pmc-12754984.creator: Stephen Olaide Aremu, Akyala Ishaku Adamu, Yakubu Boyi Ngwai, Abdillahi Abdi Barkhadle
pmc-12754984.description: IntroductionHepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a significant global health threat, with over 296 million individuals living with chronic HBV and more than 820,000 annual deaths due to related complications. Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at heightened risk due to occupational exposure, especially in sub-Saharan Africa, where HBV prevalence and health system limitations compound their vulnerability.

pmc-13138880.title: Chronic Pulmonary Aspergillosis in Children: A Scoping Global Review
pmc-13138880.creator: Filip Pavlovic, Richard Kwizera, David W Denning
pmc-13138880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundChronic pulmonary aspergillosis (CPA) affects those with underlying lung conditions or mild immunocompromise. Chronic pulmonary aspergillosis carries a poor prognosis in adults. Its pathogenesis remains obscure. We summarize all cases of CPA in children globally.MethodsFrom 6503 screened reports, we reviewed the full text of 604, of which 44 fit the inclusion criteria and an additional 11 other cases with little detail which were included under Supplementary Data.
